description.zh:
是否使用代金券抵扣购买费用，取值为：**true**或**false**（默认值）。

> 使用代金券后，若需要进行降配操作，由代金券抵扣的金额将不会进行退款。
description.en:
Specifies whether to use vouchers to offset the purchase cost. Valid values: **true** and **false** (default).

> After vouchers are used, if you need to downgrade the specifications, the amount offset by vouchers will not be refunded.

description.zh:
存储层私有定制RDS实例ID。

<props="china">> 您可以调用[DescribeDrdsRdsInstances](~~xxxx~~)查看目标PolarDB-X实例下所有存储层私有定制RDS实例详情，包括实例ID。</props>

<props="intl">> 您可以调用[DescribeDrdsRdsInstances](~~xxxx~~)查看目标DRDS实例下所有存储层RDS实例详情，包括实例ID。</props>
description.en:
The ID of the storage-layer custom ApsaraDB RDS instance.

<props="china">> You can call the [DescribeDrdsRdsInstances](~~xxxx~~) operation to query the details of all storage-layer custom ApsaraDB RDS instances under the target PolarDB-X instance, including instance IDs.</props>

<props="intl">> You can call the [DescribeDrdsRdsInstances](~~xxxx~~) operation to query the details of all storage-layer ApsaraDB RDS instances under the target DRDS instance, including instance IDs.</props>.

description.zh:
<props="china">PolarDB-X实例ID。</props>
<props="intl">DRDS实例ID。</props>
> 您可以调用[DescribeDrdsInstances](~~139284~~)查看目标账号下所有实例详情，包括实例ID。
description.en:
<props="china">The PolarDB-X instance ID.</props>
<props="intl">The DRDS instance ID.</props>
> You can call the [DescribeDrdsInstances](~~139284~~) operation to query the details of all instances under the target account, including instance IDs.

description.zh:
更新后的存储层私有定制RDS实例规格码。

> 您可以调用[DescribeAvailableClasses](~~196546~~)接口查看可购买的存储层私有定制RDS实例规格，包括规格代码和存储空间范围。
description.en:
The specification code of the storage-layer custom ApsaraDB RDS instance after the update.

> You can call the [DescribeAvailableClasses](~~196546~~) operation to query the available specifications of storage-layer custom ApsaraDB RDS instances, including specification codes and storage capacity ranges.

description.zh:
更新后的存储层私有定制RDS实例的存储空间。

> 您可以调用[DescribeAvailableClasses](~~196546~~)接口查看可购买的存储层私有定制RDS实例规格，包括规格代码和存储空间范围。
description.en:
The storage capacity of the storage-layer custom ApsaraDB RDS instance after the update.

> You can call the [DescribeAvailableClasses](~~196546~~) operation to query the available specifications of storage-layer custom ApsaraDB RDS instances, including specification codes and storage capacity ranges.

title.zh: 升级或降级存储层私有定制RDS
title.en: Upgrade or downgrade a storage-layer custom RDS instance

example.unifiedCli: aliyun drds update-private-rds-class --rds-class rds.mysql.c1.xlarge --drds-instance-id drds0000000000000 --db-instance-id rm-000000000000000 --storage 50 --auto-use-coupon true --pre-pay-duration 12 --api-version 2019-01-23 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun drds UpdatePrivateRdsClass --region cn-hangzhou --Storage 50 --DrdsInstanceId drds0000000000000 --DBInstanceId 'rm-000000000000000' --AutoUseCoupon true --RdsClass 'rds.mysql.c1.xlarge' --PrePayDuration 12
